blocks.orig: Elephant Springs by Karibu Camps and Lodges is a small, intimate camp in Tarangire National Park, among ancient baobab trees and the clear water springs that give it its name. Those springs draw a steady stream of wildlife – elephants are regular visitors, and even lions have been spotted nearby. The eco-friendly safari tents here are generously spaced for privacy and come with cosy beds, elegant furnishings, large windows, and both indoor and outdoor showers, a bathtub, and a private balcony overlooking the surrounding bush. While here, you can unwind between game drives at the infinity pool, lounge, or dining tent, all easily reachable by tuktuk even!
blocks.html: Elephant Springs by Karibu Camps and Lodges is a small and intimate camp in Tarangire National Park, set between ancient baobab trees and the clear springs it is named after. The springs attract a constant flow of wildlife – elephants come by regularly, and lions have even been seen close by. The eco-friendly safari tents stand well apart for privacy and have cosy beds, elegant furniture, large windows, indoor and outdoor showers, a bathtub and a private balcony looking out over the bush. Between game drives you can unwind at the infinity pool, in the lounge or in the dining tent, and you can even get to all of them by tuktuk!
